source_snapshot.items: US.3_USB BMC to Bay B CX9 USB Hub functional
source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC-to-Bay-B-CX9 USB hub and show all downstream devices.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_USB_BMC_to_CX9; 30 attended/30 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; filtered generic host USB list plus operator check, without Bay B/CX9 identity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; identified hub-only versus all-downstream conflict and required Bay-B/CX9-bound evidence.

old_problem: Procedure requires all Bay B CX9 downstream functions, while Criteria passes on a hub alone. A Bay A or generic hub can look identical, so filtered output can both reduce coverage and validate the wrong device.
disposition_reason: Bay B/CX9 identity is the distinct coverage, and ED-19 forbids replacing it with another hub. More importantly, hub-only and child-complete acceptance can disagree. Both evidence sets can be collected read-only, but no approved rule chooses the verdict scope; Pending and Source Conflict remain.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2171, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2172 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00059-V002 / 05b908119dc06490 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Engineer must resolve exact Bay B CX9 hub-only versus hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance.
Bind Bay B position, CX9 serial/PN/slot, exclude Bay A, and map BMC root-port/HPM/PCI-board/connectors to that hub.
Freeze exact hub and per-port CX9 child identities/speeds plus population/N/A policy.
Operator verifies/photographs Bay B and cable route; collect complete unfiltered descriptors and USB/CX9/BMC error history.
No generic/cross-bay substitution, insecure truncation, replug, reset, rebind, service/power action or retry.
No query, physical manipulation, USB/CX9 state change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Bay-B-CX9-bound BMC USB hub and downstream topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Prove the specific BMC-to-Bay-B-CX9 physical/logical USB route, exact hub and full downstream functions while preserving conflicting acceptance scopes.
required_package: Acceptance ruling for exact Bay B CX9 hub only versus all downstream devices
Bay B/CX9 serial-PN-slot identity, Bay A exclusion and complete route map
Authoritative enumeration surface and frozen hub/per-port child identity/speed manifest
Operator physical photos and complete descriptor/log access
Population/N/A, error limits, abort and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Operator proves Bay B/CX9 identity and path. Collect complete unfiltered tree, exact hub/child descriptors, speeds and reset/error history on the authoritative surface; compare hub and every child separately and report both scopes without changing USB/CX9 state.
test_case.expected_result: The exact Bay B CX9 route/hub is proven, all expected children are classified, Bay A/other hubs are excluded and management remains stable; final PASS awaits the acceptance ruling.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while source scopes conflict. Apply the future ruling to the exact hub and, if Procedure coverage is retained, every child. Wrong bay/device/route, missing required child or limit breach is FAIL under the applicable scope; missing ruling is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED for verdict until acceptance, Bay B/CX9 identity, topology and manifest are signed.
Read-only collection; operator verifies the path without replug.
No reset, deauthorize, rebind, service/firmware/power action or retry.
Stop on wrong-bay evidence, management loss, reset storm, downgrade or flapping.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and conflict disposition
Bay B/CX9 identity and operator route photos
BMC/HPM/PCI-board-to-CX9 hub map and enumeration proof
Complete hub/child descriptors/speeds and Bay-B-specific manifest comparison
Pre/post USB/CX9/BMC health and reset/error evidence
Separate hub-only/all-downstream results, recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on instability. Leave the CX9 management path unchanged and use only approved recovery; do not replug, reset, rebind, service or retry to alter the result.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure requires all Bay B CX9 downstream devices; Criteria declares PASS from hub detection alone.

blocked.reason: Both evidence scopes are collectable, but final acceptance remains Engineering Decision Pending.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Acceptance ruling, Bay B/CX9 identity, route/enumeration owner, hub/downstream oracle, N/A policy, limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION AND SOURCE CONFLICT PENDING; READ-ONLY EVIDENCE PLAN DEFINED; NO QUERY, PHYSICAL/USB/CX9 STATE CHANGE, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Test-spec owner, BMC/CX9 USB architecture owner and hardware operator
pending.unlock_condition: Approve hub-only or hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance and frozen Bay B CX9 topology/manifest, then re-review.

external_authorities.application: Preserves source coverage and target identity and prohibits silent scope reduction or stateful retry.

project_authority: Test-spec owner resolves acceptance; platform/CX9 owner defines identity/topology/manifest; operator supplies physical proof; engineer owns verdict.
